---
title: "Introduction"
---

This is a dashboard for the [MicroHub workshop](https://github.com/cdcepi/FluSight-forecast-hub/) that is organized by Northern Arizona University and the US CDC.

::: {style='display:flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center'}

[View The Latest Forecasts](forecast.html){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}

:::

The target data for for this workshop we used is SARI case counts as reported to FluID (FluID); this data is publicly available through the WHO's [Global Influenza Programme](https://www.who.int/teams/global-influenza-programme/surveillance-and-monitoring/influenza-surveillance-outputs).


This Dashboard is build with Hubverse `HubDashboard` packages. 
To learn more about Hubverse ecosystem visit <https://hubverse.io/>.
